release_notes: Session switcher (auto-rejoin last session, switch from Settings, Forget per row). Plugin Disable now reliably wipes every tracked content bucket (creatures, spells, terrain, custom races / backgrounds / classes, languages). Stats tab gains a two-column layout when the screen has the room and a minus button to burn a hit die without auto-healing. Edit-stat-block sheet no longer leaks its title into the parent screen on Mac Catalyst.
